title: Cinnamon-Apple Pork Chops

ingredients: 4 boneless pork loin chops (4 oz each)
1/2 tsp ground nutmeg (optional — original recipe has this crossed out)
directions: Season pork chops with garlic powder and cinnamon before cooking.

In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat. Add pork chops; cook 4–5 minutes on each side or until a thermometer reads 145°F. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg (if using), and salt.
Remove chops; keep warm. Add apples, pecans, brown sugar mixture, and remaining 1 tablespoon butter to pan; cook and stir until apples are tender. Serve with chops.

notes: Tip from the contributor: add more butter and brown sugar so there's extra sauce.
